package com.cowave.search.application.index.mapper

import com.commerce.proxy.shopping.product.infrastructure.consumer.dto.Product
import com.cowave.search.application.index.dto.LinkedProductRequest
import com.cowave.search.application.index.dto.UnlinkedProductDeleteRequest
import com.cowave.search.application.index.dto.UnlinkedProductRequest
import com.cowave.search.domain.index.dto.ChangedData
import com.cowave.search.domain.index.dto.LegacyProductData
import com.cowave.search.domain.proxy.category.CategoryProjection
import com.cowave.search.domain.proxy.mall.MallProjection
import java.time.Instant
import java.time.ZoneId
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter

object LegacySyncMapper {
    private val dateFormatter =
        DateTimeFormatter
            .ofPattern("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss")
            .withZone(ZoneId.of("Asia/Seoul"))

    fun convertToLinkedRequest(
        data: LegacyProductData,
        mall: MallProjection?,
    ): LinkedProductRequest =
        LinkedProductRequest(
            shopProductCode = data.mallProductId,
            shopCode = mall?.mallIdDanawa ?: "",
            prodKind = "LINK",
        )

    fun convertToUnlinkedRequest(
        data: LegacyProductData,
        category: CategoryProjection?,
        mall: MallProjection?,
    ): UnlinkedProductRequest {
        val firstPromo = data.promotions?.firstOrNull()
        return UnlinkedProductRequest(
            shopProductCode = data.mallProductId,
            shopCode = mall?.mallIdDanawa ?: "",
            productName = data.name,
            stockYN = data.hasStock.convertToYN(),
            couponDownloadYN = (data.benefit?.hasCouponDownload ?: false).convertToYN(),
            brandCertification = data.isBrandCertification.convertToYOrEmpty(),
            eventInfo = data.eventInfo ?: "",
            differentialPostYN = (data.delivery?.hasShippingGrade ?: false).convertToYN(),
            mobilePrice = data.price?.mobile ?: 0L,
            cmpnyCateCode = data.mallCategoryId ?: 0L,
            sellerId = data.sellerId ?: "",
            productImageUrl = data.imageUrl ?: "",
            addDescription = data.additionalInfo ?: "",
            shopGift = data.benefit?.gift ?: "",
            modifyDate = data.updatedAt.formatDate(),
            categoryCode1 = category?.categoryId1 ?: 0,
            categoryCode2 = category?.categoryId2 ?: 0,
            categoryCode3 = category?.categoryId3 ?: 0,
            categoryCode4 = category?.categoryId4 ?: 0,
            brand = data.mallBrandName ?: "",
            importYN = (data.isImportProduct ?: false).convertToYN(),
            totalOrderPrice = 0L,
            condition = "",
            promotionInfo = "",
            dataStat = mapDataStat(data.productStatus),
            orderDate = "",
            installationFeeYN = (data.hasInstallationCosts ?: false).convertToYN(),
            shippingInfo = data.delivery?.info ?: "",
            bestGoodsSort = "",
            promotionPrice = firstPromo?.price ?: 0L,
            isbn = data.isbn ?: "",
            model = data.manufactureDefineNumber ?: "",
            mobileUrl = data.linkUrl?.mobile ?: "",
            differentialPost = data.delivery?.shippingGradeInfo ?: "",
            adultYN = (data.isAdultRequired ?: false).convertToYOrEmpty(),
            point = data.benefit?.point ?: 0,
            groupSeq = data.mallProductCompositedId?.toLongOrNull() ?: 0L,
            pcPrice = data.price?.pc ?: 0L,
            venderId = data.vendorId ?: "",
            nointerest = data.benefit?.interestFree ?: "",
            promotionName = firstPromo?.name ?: "",
            quickTime = data.delivery?.fastDeliveryTime ?: 0,
            makeDate = data.createdAt?.let { dateFormatter.format(it) } ?: "",
            registerDate = data.collectedAt.formatDate(),
            promotionType = firstPromo?.type ?: 0,
            memberPrice = data.price?.membershipPrice ?: 0L,
            productMaker = data.mallManufacturerName ?: "",
            orderCount = 0,
            deliveryPrice = data.delivery?.shipping ?: 0,
            shopCoupon = data.benefit?.coupon ?: "",
            linkUrl = data.linkUrl?.pc ?: "",
            barcode = data.barcode ?: "",
            reviewCount = data.reviewCount ?: 0,
            shipping = data.delivery?.shipping ?: 0,
        )
    }

    fun convertToUnlinkedDeleteRequest(
        data: LegacyProductData,
        mall: MallProjection?,
    ): UnlinkedProductDeleteRequest =
        UnlinkedProductDeleteRequest(
            shopCode = mall?.mallIdDanawa ?: "",
            shopProductCode = data.mallProductId,
        )

    private fun Boolean.convertToYN(): String = if (this) "Y" else "N"

    private fun Boolean.convertToYOrEmpty(): String = if (this) "Y" else ""

    private fun Instant.formatDate(): String = dateFormatter.format(this)

    fun convertToChangedLegacyData(changedData: List<ChangedData<Product>>): List<ChangedData<LegacyProductData>> =
        changedData.map { changed ->
            ChangedData(
                id = changed.id,
                op = changed.op,
                beforeData = changed.beforeData?.convertToLegacyProduct(),
                afterData = changed.afterData?.convertToLegacyProduct(),
                partition = changed.partition,
                offset = changed.offset,
            )
        }

    private fun Product.convertToLegacyProduct(): LegacyProductData {
        val danawaChannel = channelDatas?.get("DANAWA")
        return LegacyProductData(
            id = `id$1`.toString(),
            name = name,
            shopId = mallId,
            mallProductId = mallProductId,
            mallProductCompositedId = mallProductCompositedId,
            categoryId = categoryId,
            mallCategory = mallCategory,
            mallCategoryId = mallCategoryId,
            mallBrandName = mallBrandName,
            brandId = brandId,
            mallManufacturerName = mallManufacturerName,
            manufacturerId = manufacturerId,
            manufactureDefineNumber = manufactureDefineNumber,
            imageUrl = imageUrl,
            hasStock = hasStock ?: false,
            productStatus = collectedStatus ?: "ACTIVE",
            isCatalogMatch = catalogMatchings?.any { it.source != "NONE" } ?: false,
            isUsedProduct = isUsedProduct ?: false,
            isRefurbished = isRefurbished ?: false,
            isImportProduct = isImportProduct,
            hasInstallationCosts = hasInstallationCosts,
            barcode = barcode,
            sellerId = sellerId,
            reviewCount = reviewCount,
            vendorId = vendorId,
            additionalInfo = additionalInfo,
            collectedAt = collectedAt ?: Instant.now(),
            updatedAt = updatedAt ?: Instant.now(),
            createdAt = createdAt,
            linkUrl =
                danawaChannel?.url?.let {
                    LegacyProductData.LegacyUrl(pc = it.pc, mobile = it.mobile)
                },
            price =
                danawaChannel?.price?.let {
                    LegacyProductData.LegacyPrice(
                        pc = it.pc,
                        mobile = it.mobile,
                        membershipPrice = it.membershipPrice,
                    )
                },
            delivery =
                delivery?.let {
                    LegacyProductData.LegacyDelivery(
                        shipping = it.shipping,
                        originalShipping = it.originalShipping,
                        isConditionalShipping = it.isConditionalShipping,
                        hasShippingGrade = it.hasShippingGrade,
                        shippingGradeInfo = it.shippingGradeInfo,
                        info = it.info,
                        fastDeliveryTime = it.fastDeliveryTime,
                    )
                },
            isbn = isbn,
            isAdultRequired = isAdultRequired,
            isBrandCertification = brandAlliance != null,
            benefit =
                danawaChannel?.benefit?.let {
                    LegacyProductData.LegacyBenefit(
                        point = it.point,
                        coupon = it.coupon,
                        interestFree = it.interestFree,
                        gift = it.gift,
                        hasCouponDownload = it.hasCouponDownload,
                    )
                },
            promotions =
                danawaChannel?.promotions?.map {
                    LegacyProductData.LegacyPromotion(
                        type = it.type,
                        name = it.name,
                        price = it.price,
                    )
                },
            eventInfo = danawaChannel?.eventInfo,
        )
    }

    private fun mapDataStat(status: String): String =
        when (status) {
            "ACTIVE" -> "N"
            else -> "Y"
        }
}

fun ChangedData<Product>.toIndexDocument(
    category: CategoryProjection?,
    mall: MallProjection?,
    brandProjection: BrandProjection?,
    manufacturerProjection: ManufacturerProjection?,
): IndexDocument<ProductDocument> =
    with(this) {
        IndexDocument(
            id = id,
            op = op,
            // CREATE 시 category, mall만 not null을 보장 (validated from caller)
            createDocument =
                if (op ==Operation.CREATE) {
                    this.afterData!!.toProductDocument(
                        category!!, mall!!, brandProjection, manufacturerProjection)
                } else null,
            updateData =
                if (op == Operation.UPDATE) {
                    this.afterData!!.toMap(category, mall, brandProjection, manufacturerProjection)
                } else null,
        )
    }

private fun Product.getId(): Long = `id$1`

private fun Product.toProductDocument(
    category: CategoryProjection,
    mall: MallProjection,
    brandProjection: BrandProjection?,
    manufacturerProjection: ManufacturerProjection?,
): ProductDocument =
    with(this) {
        ProductDocument(
            id = getId(),
            name = name,
            categoryId = categoryId,
            categoryId1 = category.categoryId1,
            categoryId2 = category.categoryId2,
            categoryId3 = category.categoryId3,
            categoryId4 = category.categoryId4,
            categoryNames = category.categoryNames,
            isActiveCategory = category.isActiveCategory,
            brandId = brandId,
            brandName = brandProjection?.name ?: mallBrandName,
            manufacturerId = manufacturerId,
            manufacturerName = manufacturerProjection?.name,
            mallId = mallId,
            mallProductId = mallProductId,
            mallBrandName = mallBrandName,
            mallManufacturerName = mallManufacturerName,
            manufactureDefineNumber = manufactureDefineNumber,
            productStatus = ProductStatus.of(collectedStatus),
            isCatalogMatch = ProductDocument.Policy.determineIsCatalogMatch(catalogMatchings),
            isAiMatch = ProductDocument.Policy.determineIsAiMatch(catalogMatchings),
            isOfficialWarranty = ProductDocument.Policy.determineIsOfficialWarranty(warrantyAlliance),
            isBrandCertification = ProductDocument.Policy.determineIsBrandCertification(brandAlliance),
            isFastDelivery = ProductDocument.Policy.determineIsFastDelivery(delivery?.fastDeliveryTime),
            isUsedProduct = isUsedProduct,
            isRefurbished = isRefurbished,
            registeredAt = collectedAt,
            createdAt = createdAt,
            updatedAt = updatedAt,
            danawa = convertToProductChannelData(

            ),
            enuri = convertToProductChannelData(
                channelDatas["ENURI"], mall.isActiveEnuriMall, delivery?.shipping ?: 0
            ),
        )
    }

private fun convertToProductChannelData(
    channelData: ChannelData?,
    isActiveMall: Boolean,
    deliveryCharge: Int = 0,
): ProductChannelData =
    if (channelData != null) {
        with(channelData) {
            ProductChannelData(
                status = ProductChannelStatus(
                    hasData = true,
                    isActiveMall = isActiveMall,
                ),
                price = ProductChannelPrice(
                    lowestPrice = price.pc.toInt(),
                    membershipPrice = price.membershipPrice?.toInt(),
                    deliveryCharge = deliveryCharge,
                ),
                stats = ProductChannelStats(),
                benefit = ProductChannelBenefit(), // TODO 통합DB에 아직 카드이름 정보가 없음
            )
        }
    } else ProductChannelData.empty(isActiveMall)

fun Product.toMap(
    category: CategoryProjection?,
    mall: MallProjection?,
    brandProjection: BrandProjection?,
    manufacturerProjection: ManufacturerProjection?,
): Map<String, Any?> {
    val productStatus = ProductStatus.of(collectedStatus)
    val isCatalogMatch = ProductDocument.Policy.determineIsCatalogMatch(catalogMatchings)

    return mutableMapOf<String, Any?>(
        ProductDocument::id.name to getId(),
        ProductDocument::name.name to name,
        ProductDocument::categoryId.name to categoryId,
        ProductDocument::brandId.name to brandId,
        ProductDocument::manufacturerId.name to manufacturerId,
        ProductDocument::mallId.name to mallId,
        ProductDocument::mallProductId.name to mallProductId,
        ProductDocument::mallBrandName.name to mallBrandName,
        ProductDocument::mallManufacturerName.name to mallManufacturerName,
        ProductDocument::manufactureDefineNumber.name to manufactureDefineNumber,
        ProductDocument::productStatus.name to productStatus,
        ProductDocument::isCatalogMatch.name to isCatalogMatch,
        ProductDocument::isAiMatch.name to ProductDocument.Policy.determineIsAiMatch(catalogMatchings),
        ProductDocument::isOfficialWarranty.name to ProductDocument.Policy.determineIsOfficialWarranty(warrantyAlliance),
        ProductDocument::isBrandCertification.name to ProductDocument.Policy.determineIsBrandCertification(brandAlliance),
        ProductDocument::isFastDelivery.name to ProductDocument.Policy.determineIsFastDelivery(delivery?.fastDeliveryTime),
        ProductDocument::isUsedProduct.name to isUsedProduct,
        ProductDocument::isRefurbished.name to isRefurbished,
        ProductDocument::registeredAt.name to collectedAt,
        ProductDocument::updatedAt.name to updatedAt,
        ProductDocument::createdAt.name to createdAt,
        ProductDocument::danawa.name to convertToProductChannelDataMap(
            channelData = channelDatas["DANAWA"],
            productStatus = productStatus,
            deliveryCharge = delivery?.shipping ?: 0,
        ),
        ProductDocument::enuri.name to convertToProductChannelDataMap(
            channelData = channelDatas["ENURI"],
            productStatus = productStatus,
            deliveryCharge = delivery?.shipping ?: 0,
        ),
        ProductDocument::totalSearchable.name to ProductDocument.Policy.determineTotalSearchable(isCatalogMatch),
    ).apply {
        brandProjection?.let {
            put(ProductDocument::brandName.name, it.name)
        }
        manufacturerProjection?.let {
            put(ProductDocument::manufacturerName.name, it.name)
        }
        category?.let {
            put(ProductDocument::categoryId1.name, it.categoryId1)
            put(ProductDocument::categoryId2.name, it.categoryId2)
            put(ProductDocument::categoryId3.name, it.categoryId3)
            put(ProductDocument::categoryId4.name, it.categoryId4)
            put(ProductDocument::categoryNames.name, it.categoryNames)
            put(ProductDocument::isActiveCategory.name, it.isActiveCategory)
        }
    }
}

private fun convertToProductChannelDataMap(
    channelData: ChannelData?,
    productStatus: ProductStatus,
    deliveryCharge: Int = 0,
): Map<String, Any?> =
    if (channelData != null) {
        with(channelData) {
            val lowestTotalPrice = ChannelPrice.determineTotalPrice(price.pc.toInt(), deliveryCharge)!!
            val membershipTotalPrice = ChannelPrice.determineTotalPrice(price.membershipPrice?.toInt(), deliveryCharge)

            mapOf(
                ProductChannelData::status.name to mapOf(
                    ProductChannelStatus::hasData.name to true,
                    // FIXME

                    ProductChannelStatus::isActiveMall.name to true,
                    ProductChannelStatus::display.name to
                            ProductDocument.Policy.determineDisplay(
                                // FIXME
                                //  업데이트의 경우 외부 도메인을 fetch하지 않아 isActiveCategory를 알 수 없다.
                                //  일단 보수적으로 true로 설정해두지만 정확하게 업데이트 되도록 수정해야 한다.
                                isActiveCategory = true,
                                isActiveMall = true,
                                hasData = true,
                                productStatus = productStatus,
                            ),
                    ProductChannelStatus::isCoupangWow.name to
                            ProductDocument.Policy.determineIsCoupangWow(price.membershipPrice?.toInt()),
                ),
                ProductChannelData::price.name to mapOf(
                    ProductChannelPrice::lowestPrice.name to price.pc.toInt(),
                    ProductChannelPrice::membershipPrice.name to price.membershipPrice?.toInt(),
                    ProductChannelPrice::deliveryCharge.name to deliveryCharge,
                    ProductChannelPrice::lowestTotalPrice.name to lowestTotalPrice,
                    ProductChannelPrice::membershipTotalPrice.name to membershipTotalPrice,
                    ProductChannelPrice::lowestMembershipPrice.name to
                            ChannelPrice.determinePrice(price.pc.toInt(), price.membershipPrice?.toInt()),
                    ProductChannelPrice::lowestMembershipTotalPrice.name to
                            ChannelPrice.determinePrice(lowestTotalPrice, membershipTotalPrice),
                ),
                ProductChannelData::stats.name to mapOf(
                    ProductChannelStats::popularityScore.name to 0,
                    ProductChannelStats::reviewCount.name to 0,
                    ProductChannelStats::salesCount.name to 0,
                ),
                ProductChannelData::benefit.name to mapOf(
                    ProductChannelBenefit::cardName.name to null, // TODO
                ),
            )
        }
    } else {
        mapOf(
            ProductChannelData::status.name to mapOf(
                ProductChannelStatus::hasData.name to false,
                // FIXME
                //  업데이트의 경우 외부 도메인을 fetch하지 않아 isActiveMall 알 수 없다.
                //  일단 보수적으로 true로 설정해두지만 정확하게 업데이트 되도록 수정해야 한다
                //  (isActiveMall == false 이면 애시당초 CDC 이벤트가 발생하지 않는다.)
                ProductChannelStatus::isActiveMall.name to true,
                ProductChannelStatus::display.name to false,
                ProductChannelStatus::isCoupangWow.name to null,
            ),
            ProductChannelData::price.name to null,
            ProductChannelData::stats.name to null,
            ProductChannelData::benefit.name to null,
        )
    }
